content: BAWIPA teh a thoung dawkvah pholen awh

content.text: BAWIPA ni a uk, tami pueng pâyaw naseh.
Ama teh cherubim rahak ao.
Talai kâhuen naseh.
BAWIPA teh Zion vah a lentoe teh,
tami pueng hlak tawm lah ao.
Ka lentoe e hoi takikatho e na min hah,
pholen awh naseh, ama teh a thoung.
Siangpahrang thaonae ni hai kângingnae teh a pahren teh,
kânging e lawkcengnae hah a caksak.
Jakop koe lannae hoi kângingnae hah a kangdue sak.
BAWIPA Cathut teh tawm awh nateh,
a khok koe bawk awh, ama teh a thoung.
Mosi hoi Aron teh a vaihmanaw thung e doeh.
Samuel teh a min kakawnaw thung e doeh.
Ahnimouh ni BAWIPA hah a kaw awh teh, ama ni a pato.
Tâmai thung hoi ahnimouh koe lawk a dei teh,
ahnimouh koe a poe e lawkpanuesaknae hoi
a phunglam hah a tarawi.
Oe, BAWIPA kaimae Cathut, nang ni na pato awh.
A sak awh e dawk moi na pathung nakunghai,
nang teh ahnimouh na ka ngaithoumkung lah na o.
BAWIPA maimae Cathut teh tawmrasang awh nateh,
amon kathoung dawk ama teh bawk awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA maimae Cathut teh a thoung.
